Description: Adds 2 Block to an Ally or Self.
Root an enemy within 5 tiles. It cannot move on its next turn, but it can still attack.
Freeze an enemy within 5 tiles. It loses its entire next turn.
Move to any tile on the board.
Deal 5 damage to an enemy within 5 tiles.
Deal 4 damage to everyone in a cone.
Sets three tiles alight. Anything standing there takes 4 damage at the end of the turn, for 2 turns.
Raises a wall of force across three tiles. Nothing may move onto them for 2 turns.
Summons a Totem that weakens nearby enemies.
Summons a skeleton ally that fights for you for 3 turns.
